name: The Thermal Vents
layout: Volcanic ridges, black smoker chimneys and basalt plateaus spewing superheated mineral plumes. Boiling water pillars damage hulls with heat and cause turbulence. Rich in copper and thermal energy.
look: Hazy, heat-distorted water, red magma glowing through cracks in the basalt, black mineral clouds and armor-plated fauna.
hazards: Extreme heat stress on the hull (needs Thermal Hull Shielding), sudden geysers, turbulence that throws subs against volcanic glass, and the Boiler Worm erupting from the rock.
foodWeb: Vent bacteria and vent flora feed the plankton, the armored grazers (Basalt Plate Crab, Iron-Foot Snail) and heat-resistant filter feeders (Crimson Plume Tubeworm, Smoker Mussel). Those feed plated mesopredators like the Vent-Shark, Magma-Snapper and Scald Octopus, while scavengers clean up carcasses and bone falls. The Pyroclast Megalodon, Caldera Kraken and Sulfurmaw Leviathan hunt the large mesopredators, and the vibration-tracking Boiler Worm swallows Ashmaw Baskers, whole schools and noisy subs.
source: The Deep Design Document.pdf, The ten ecosystems (4. The Thermal Vents, pages 46-57), and Crafting, resources, and upgrades (Thermal Hull Shielding); the Featured species section has no vents entry

fauna.name: Sulfur Mote Copepod
fauna.description: Copepod drifting in dense yellow clouds that ride the rising plumes.

fauna.name: Ember Krill
fauna.description: Krill glowing faint orange in swarms that drift through the plumes.

fauna.behavior: Tiny jellies pooled where hot and cold layers meet; mildly stinging

fauna.name: Ash Drift Amphipod
fauna.description: Amphipod drifting in the ash snow that swarms onto fresh blood.
fauna.tactics: Drifts in ash snow and swarms onto fresh blood within seconds, marking any wound.
fauna.behavior: Drifts in ash snow; swarms onto fresh blood within seconds

fauna.tactics: Clicks its claws; wedges into basalt cracks when threatened.
fauna.behavior: Armored vent crab; clicks claws, wedges into basalt cracks when threatened

fauna.name: Sulfur Limpet
fauna.description: Limpet clamped to chimney walls that scrapes sulfur films at night.
fauna.tactics: Clamps to chimney walls; slowly scrapes sulfur films at night.
fauna.behavior: Clamps to chimney walls; slowly scrapes sulfur films at night

fauna.name: Iron-Foot Snail
fauna.description: Snail with a magnetic, iron-sulfide scaled foot that clusters near the hottest vents.
fauna.tactics: Clusters near the hottest vents, where little can follow it; its scaled foot is magnetic.
fauna.behavior: Iron-sulfide scaled foot; magnetic; clusters near the hottest vents

fauna.tactics: Thousands mob chimney rims; a back-eye senses the magma glow.

fauna.name: Boiler Worm
fauna.description: The vents' resident giant: a 60 m worm that lives in the basalt and tracks rock vibration.
fauna.tactics: Lies in the rock and tracks vibration through the basalt: grinding beaks, booming grunts, footfalls and engine noise. Without warning it erupts from the basalt beneath its target and swallows whole schools, Ashmaw Baskers and noisy subs in one strike, then sinks back into the rock. Staying quiet and off the plateaus keeps it below; an Ashmaw Basker is prime bait to draw it elsewhere.
fauna.behavior: Tracks rock vibration; erupts from the basalt and swallows schools and subs

interactions: Boiling water pillars damage hulls with heat and throw subs against volcanic glass; without Thermal Hull Shielding the heat stress builds fast near the smokers, and geysers erupt without warning.

The Boiler Worm tracks vibration through the basalt and erupts from the rock to swallow Ashmaw Baskers, whole schools and noisy subs. The Basalt Rasp Turtle's grinding beak and the Slag Grouper's booming grunts draw it across the plateaus; an Ashmaw Basker is prime bait to lure it away.
The Pyroclast Megalodon homes in on engine Low-band noise; the Vent-Shark is drawn by blood and Mid-band noise and rams subs.
The Caldera Kraken lairs inside the caldera rims and drags prey into the boiling pillars; the Sulfurmaw Leviathan sits disguised as a smoker chimney and vacuum-gulps anything that strays close.
Sulfur Mote Copepod clouds ride the rising plumes and throw a blinding murk around the chimneys; Ember Krill swarms scatter from hull lights above 50 lux.
Each eruption sends Cinder Larva Swarms sinking in ash-grey columns that feed the Ember Blennies, Scald Clams and Chimney Barnacles below.
Ash Drift Amphipods swarm onto fresh blood within seconds; Ember Rattails are first to arrive at carcasses and blood, and the Pumice Sleeper Shark turns aggressive once the blood passes a threshold.
Slagbone Worms dissolve the bones of Ashmaw Basker falls, feeding Soot Hagfish, Sulfur Snailfish and Smoke Brittle-Stars; Ash Gulpers swallow carcass chunks whole.
Crimson Plume Tubeworms snap into their tubes at shadows and Pompeii Ember-Worms retreat on vibration, so a passing sub empties the chimney beds.

Glowjaw Viperfish mimic ember glow and Obsidian Anglerfish dangle a 5 lux lure that mimics magma glow; Kiln Barracuda charge flashing lights and dangling lures, and Pyre Shrimp sense the magma glow with an eye on their backs.
Brimstone Squid packs squirt sulfur-yellow ink that blinds sonar; Ashwing Rays erupt in grey clouds when stepped near.

Divers' hazards: Kiln Anemones burn on contact, Smolder Urchin spines are red-hot, Basalt Mantis Shrimp clubs crack visors, Smelter Spider-Crab claws pinch through suits, Ember Stargazers' jolts drain suit batteries, Ashcoil Sea Snakes carry potent venom and Magma-Snappers bite hard enough to crack hull glass.
Scald Octopuses shift color with the water temperature, pry shells open and steal loot; Clinker Crabs swarm wrecks and pick at loot crates.
Copperback Triggerfish guard their nests and bite divers; Slag Grouper grunts and Ember Blenny chirps warn intruders off and give a diver's position away.

Ash Spires crumble under sonar pings; Eruptor Algae bladders burst violently when disturbed; Grit Spores puff on contact and clog filters; Choke Vent-Grass snares fish; Scald Crust shears weak drills and Blaze Filament can only be cut with the Mid-Tier Drill.
Smoker Stalks puff black smoke that, as Smoke Resin, makes smoke-screen decoys masking light and blood; Vapor Prawns hide in the steam bubbles of Vapor Stalks.
Furnace Slugs store the stolen stings of the Kiln Anemones they eat; Ashback Sea Cucumbers eject heat-absorbing gel when attacked; Soot Hagfish flood attackers with fireproof slime.
Thermal Hull Shielding is made here: Ash Ceramic Powder from Ash Spires, Vent-Shark Hide Plate and Basalt Fiber, with Titanium Hull Plates from the shallower biomes.
